criterion: Recorded round corruption and reference integrity
scope: Default recorder object loading and restricted pickle globals.
finding: RestrictedUnpickler allows explicit module/name pairs and raises UnpicklingError for other globals. Recorder loading uses it by default, wraps failures and does not silently retry as unrestricted pickle.
limitation: Type admission is distinct from a content digest, ordered research-round/reference validation or tamper authenticity. An attacker able to rewrite allowed data can change values without violating a class allowlist; trusted/custom loading explicitly changes the boundary.

criterion: Crash/restart consistency and durable commit frontier
scope: Mongo task claim/result transitions and recorder completion.
finding: Task fetching uses find_one_and_update to claim a waiting task; ordinary exceptions and KeyboardInterrupt return it to the prior status, and a result/status update is submitted together. Recorder completion waits for its AsyncCaller before ending the MLflow run.
limitation: A hard kill can bypass the return context; lease recovery and an atomic transaction spanning MLflow artifacts and task state were not established. The separate AsyncCaller probe shows join can return after a logging callback failed, so recorder completion alone is not evidence that all queued logging succeeded; MLflow itself was not executed.

criterion: Parallel worker failure handling and bounded dispatch
scope: Native AsyncCaller callback exception propagation.
finding: A harmless ValueError callback ran and terminated the worker thread. Native wait() returned normally without raising; the following queued callback never ran and two queue items remained. The bounded probe captured the thread exception and worker termination.
limitation: This is a reproduced AsyncCaller failure, not a claim that every Qlib worker loses errors. The MLflowRecorder use of this helper was inspected but no recorder, MLflow server or remote storage operation was executed.

criterion: Inference output validity and unavailable-signal behavior
scope: Cached model signal to native signal strategy.
finding: ModelSignal calls the model's predict method, converts a DataFrame result to its first column and caches it. The strategy requests the preceding prediction interval and returns an empty trade decision when the result is None.
limitation: The inspected boundary does not establish universal shape, finite-value or probability-range validation of custom model outputs. Scores need not be probabilities; missing-result handling is specific to this strategy and does not prove all strategies stop on invalid inference.

criterion: Execution chronology and source evidence admission
scope: Period-scoped signal selection and configured execution quotes.
finding: The native Topk strategy requests predictions from the preceding trade interval, and SignalWCache selects signal data within requested start/end bounds. Orders carry their execution interval to Exchange quote selection.
limitation: Correct timestamps, model fit boundaries and causal feature construction remain prerequisites. A period selection cannot repair a full-data predictor that used future observations; period aggregate prices do not prove tick-level availability or execution order.

criterion: Economic affordability, exposure and quantity constraints

finding: The position-backed route clips sales to holdings, checks cash against minimum/variable costs, reduces unaffordable buys and rounds amounts through its trade-unit rule. Configured volume limits can further clip the executable amount.
limitation: The cash/holding guarantee is conditional on supplying a position and valid economic inputs; a position=None route deliberately omits the balance gate. Lot rounding is configuration dependent. This is simulated admission, not a live capital guarantee or general fee/NaN validation.

criterion: Exit rules, gap treatment and execution uncertainty

limitation: This is a period-price execution model. It does not establish stop precedence, path inside an OHLC bar, order-book queue position or real-world protective fills. Those semantics must be supplied and matched before an execution comparison.

limitation: add_task does not impose a general process-count, per-strategy memory or execution-time quota. Coordinator bounds apply to the inspected auxiliary source, whose identity with the installed native wheel is unverified; no hostile-load or shutdown stress run was performed.

criterion: Recorded round corruption and reference integrity
scope: Local pickle cache corruption behavior and coordinator generation checks.
finding: The cache catches selected decoding/missing-file failures and removes or resets the affected cache metadata, returning a cache miss. The native coordinator rejects a stale generation before mutation after service restart.
limitation: Cache recovery deliberately mutates metadata and is not immutable research-round fail-closed admission; other valid pickle values can be accepted without expected content hashes. Local pickle is trusted code/data. Coordinator generation is service-session identity, not durable experiment evidence.

criterion: Crash/restart consistency and durable commit frontier
scope: Cache/session writes and ephemeral coordinator state.
finding: Cache set writes metadata before the value file, using separate direct pickle writes. Backtest session result/status updates are database operations, while coordinator restart is detected through a changed generation.
limitation: No atomic frontier spanning cache metadata, result files, database session state and strategy execution was established. Direct cache writes can be interrupted; a detected coordinator restart does not recover its previous state. Process-kill or power-loss recovery was not executed.

criterion: Parallel worker failure handling and bounded dispatch
scope: Python child-process failure publication and shutdown cleanup.
finding: The child wrapper catches ordinary exceptions, publishes exception details and terminates the session. Failed starts remove the process registration. Shutdown requests cooperative cancellation and escalates to terminate/kill; cleanup joins and removes dead workers.
limitation: Publication depends on the coordinator remaining available. These paths do not prove exact resume from the completed task prefix, durable failure delivery, absence of all orphans or correctness under hard process death and shutdown races; no live services were exercised.

criterion: Inference output validity and unavailable-signal behavior
scope: Changed strategy protective-order outputs before downstream execution.
finding: Changed stop-loss and take-profit arrays pass finite quantity/price checks before the saved protective array is updated and existing stop orders are canceled.
limitation: This is a concrete strategy-output safety gate, not a shared fitted-probability model contract. A generic model's shape, unavailable-inference representation and downstream behavior still belong to its adapter. The check does not establish validity of all order semantics.

criterion: Execution chronology and source evidence admission

limitation: The clock trusts supplied observations; source authenticity, causal strategy features and intra-bar path remain separate. Fast/native aggregation code also requires the auxiliary source-to-binary identity caveat. Equivalent slow/fast outcomes were not tested in this safety campaign.

criterion: Economic affordability, exposure and quantity constraints
scope: Simulated spot affordability and futures margin admission.
finding: Futures order submission rejects non-reducing orders that exceed available margin before booking the reservation. Spot submission rejects excessive spend or sale, but the buy branch subtracts cash before raising InsufficientBalance.
limitation: The spot failure path does not restore the prior balance within the inspected method; a fresh aborted-run reset is a different contract from continuing after a caught exception. Both methods return early in live mode, so this evidence cannot establish live exchange risk enforcement. No live order or spot failure probe was executed.

limitation: The liquidation function returns without that simulation unless the position mode is isolated. Bar-level fills, bankruptcy price and barrier ordering are model assumptions; cross-margin and live capital behavior require separate evidence. No guaranteed real protective fill follows.
